subject: Creativity
title: Conspiracy Thinking: Imagination Without Evidence
description: A quick win: understand Conspiracy Thinking: Imagination Without Evidence.

hook.text: Conspiracy theories are creative narratives — they connect unrelated events into compelling stories.

buildup.text: The human brain is a pattern-detection machine. It finds patterns even in random noise — a phenomenon called apophenia.

discovery.text: Conspiracy thinking combines apophenia with intentionality bias — the assumption that events have deliberate causes.

twist.text: People prone to conspiracy thinking also score higher on creativity measures — pattern-finding gone off the rails.

climax.text: The antidote isn't less imagination. It's better critical thinking — the ability to evaluate which connections are real.

punchline.text: Conspiracy theories are creativity without a fact-checker.
